name: Quality doubt objection
description: Customer receives a quote then expresses doubt about quality based on past bad experiences, testing the AI's ability to handle a quality objection with reassurance and guarantees

messages.text: Hi, my name is Thabo. Can I get a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm?
Is this good quality? I've had bad boards before

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the objection with empathy and provide quality reassurance or warranty information
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Quality objection. AI should acknowledge past bad experiences, explain product quality standards, grade, or warranty, and re-attempt a close.
